title: 1988 Donruss #303 Tom Foley Montreal Expos Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
Up for sale is a 1988 Donruss baseball card featuring Tom Foley, card number 303. This sports trading card is an original and licensed reprint, in English language, from the manufacturer Donruss in the United States. The card belongs to the set 1988 Donruss and is categorized under Trading Card Singles, Sports Trading Cards, and Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop. 

The card is associated with the Montreal Expos team in the Major League (MLB) and has not been autographed. This card is not vintage but is from the season 1988. Get this amazing baseball card for your collection today!
